name: OpenVPN Client
description: Installs OpenVPN client for connecting to VPN networks

enabled.description: Enable the OpenVPN feature. Set to false to skip installation completely.

autoConnect.description: Automatically initialize and connect to VPN on container start. Set to false to only install the OpenVPN client.

configDir.description: Directory where OpenVPN configuration files will be stored. If empty, defaults to $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/openvpn or $HOME/.config/openvpn.
